figurative_meaning_en: To overwhelm someone by putting them in trouble or distress
similar_in_english: to throw someone into the dark
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার প্রতিদ্বন্দ্বীকে অন্ধকার দেখিয়ে ভয় দেখাল।
পুলিশ অপরাধীকে অন্ধকার দেখানোর হুমকি দিল।
example_sentences_in_english: He showed darkness to his rival to intimidate him.
The police threatened the criminal by showing him darkness.
note: This idiom metaphorically implies creating fear through impending trouble, common in Bengali verbal confrontations.
